topology_edges.conditional_mechanism: If FOMC minutes indicate support for a rate cut, then the Federal Reserve may adjust interest rates.
If the US annual inflation rate changes, this provides data enabling the Federal Reserve to adjust interest rates.
If market expectations anticipate a Federal Reserve interest rate adjustment, this correlates with Federal Reserve interest rate adjustments.
If the Federal Reserve adjusts interest rates, this causes the attractiveness of newly issued bonds to change.
If the attractiveness of newly issued bonds changes, investors shift towards existing bonds with higher yields.
If the US annual inflation rate changes, this causes changes in the inflation risk premium embedded in bond yields.
If investors shift towards existing bonds with higher yields, this influences the target metric.
If the inflation risk premium embedded in bond yields changes, this influences the target metric.
If the Federal Reserve adjusts interest rates, this influences the target metric.
